_comment: Claim ledger source for scripts/make_evidence_map.py. Literature metadata is copied from docs/REFERENCES.md and is PENDING verification. Scripts that produce results must append model/dataset claims with artifact_path, command, commit_sha, run_id and seed; nothing may be marked VERIFIED without a named reviewer.

claims.exact_claim: Dynamical decoupling of open quantum systems was introduced by Viola, Knill and Lloyd (1999). [bib key Viola1999]
Uhrig (2007) proposed optimized pi-pulse sequences for keeping a qubit coherent. [bib key Uhrig2007]
Cywinski et al. (2008) analysed how to enhance dephasing times in superconducting qubits. [bib key Cywinski2008]
Biercuk et al. (2009) studied optimized dynamical decoupling in a model quantum memory. [bib key Biercuk2009]
Bylander et al. (2011) performed noise spectroscopy through dynamical decoupling with a superconducting flux qubit. [bib key Bylander2011]
Alvarez and Suter (2011) measured the spectrum of colored noise by dynamical decoupling. [bib key Alvarez2011]
Souza, Alvarez and Suter (2011) studied robust dynamical decoupling for quantum computing and quantum memory. [bib key Souza2011]
Ezzell et al. (2023) surveyed the performance of dynamical decoupling for superconducting qubits. [bib key Ezzell2023]
Rahman, Egger and Arenz (2024) studied learning how to dynamically decouple. [bib key Rahman2024]
Tong, Zhang and Pokharel (2025) studied empirical learning of dynamical decoupling on quantum processors. [bib key Tong2025]
Tong et al. (2026) studied learning error suppression strategies for dynamic quantum circuits. [bib key Tong2026]
The optimizer is the CMA evolution strategy, described in the tutorial by Hansen (2016). [bib key Hansen2016]

The project motivation comes from a Quantum Machines/Columbia course project-ideas brief (2026) supplied by the team; it is not a public refereed source and is not evidence of this project's implementation or hardware access. [bib key QMBrief2026]
No quantum-hardware (IQCC) execution has been performed for this report and no measured data are reported.
All simulation experiments are NOT RUN in this draft; no numerical result is reported.
